summary: Spawns trail particles from three collision-effect slots (this[8], this[9], this[10], offsets 0x20/0x24/0x28) whenever the collision point has moved enough since the last frame. An emitter-mode argument a6 is derived from the smoke/renderer flags (byte_7CF9BC, byte_7CF9EC), and emission is gated per slot by the collision strength stored in the a2 state, the slot pointer, and the throttle counters (dword_7CF8A8, dword_8AB6E4, dword_7C5698). On significant movement (vertical delta beyond 0.15/0.06, or squared horizontal distance beyond 1.0/0.16) it updates the tracked position, builds a noise-jittered spawn position from flt_8AB274 indexed by the ring counter dword_8AAE70, scales the a5 velocity by 0.1, and calls ParticleTrailEmitter (0x004CBC50). The third slot additionally spawns a secondary offset trail at higher render-throttle detail. Called from tire-slip force calculation (0x004472B0) and 0x004EE2D0.

operations.description: Derive the emitter-mode argument a6 from the smoke/renderer flags: when byte_7CF9BC is set and byte_7CF9EC is set use 104; when both flags are clear use -1; otherwise keep the incoming a6.

Slot-8 emission gate: requires the collision strength at a2+0 to be non-zero, the slot pointer this[8] (offset 0x20) to be set, and the throttle condition dword_7CF8A8 > 2, dword_8AB6E4 == 2, or dword_7C5698 % 20 == 0.
Slot-8 movement test: emit only when the vertical delta from the last tracked collision height exceeds 0.15000001, or the squared horizontal distance from the tracked position exceeds 1.0.
Update the tracked collision state at a2 (position components, collision height a3, and velocity) to the current frame's values.
Build the jittered spawn position for slot 8: offset the collision point by flt_8AB274[ring counter dword_8AAE70++] scaled by 0.25, and scale the a5 velocity components by 0.1.
Emit the slot-8 trail particle via ParticleTrailEmitter (0x004CBC50) with the slot pointer this[8], the collision height, the jittered position, the scaled velocity and the emitter-mode a6.
Slot-9 emission gate: same throttle condition with the collision strength at a2+20 and the slot pointer this[9] (offset 0x24).
Slot-9 movement test: vertical delta beyond 0.15000001, or squared horizontal distance beyond 1.0.
Update the slot-9 tracked collision state at a2 (positions around a2+28, height a2+24, velocity a2+36).
Build the jittered spawn position for slot 9 using flt_8AB274[ring counter dword_8AAE70++] and the 0.25/0.1 scalings.
Emit the slot-9 trail particle via ParticleTrailEmitter (0x004CBC50) with the slot pointer this[9] (offset 0x24).

Slot-10 emission gate: requires the collision strength at a2+40 and the slot pointer this[10] (offset 0x28), with the slightly weaker throttle condition dword_7CF8A8 > 1, dword_8AB6E4 == 2, or dword_7C5698 % 20 == 0.
Slot-10 movement test: vertical delta beyond 0.059999999, or squared horizontal distance beyond 0.16000001.
Update the slot-10 tracked collision state at a2 (positions around a2+48, height a2+44, velocity a2+56).
Build the jittered spawn position for slot 10 using flt_8AB274[ring counter dword_8AAE70++] with the finer 0.15000001 offset scaling and the 0.1 velocity scaling.
Emit the slot-10 trail particle via ParticleTrailEmitter (0x004CBC50) with the slot pointer this[10] (offset 0x28).

When dword_7CF8A8 > 2 (high render-throttle detail), also spawn a secondary offset trail from slot this[10]: offset the spawn position backward by a5 scaled by 0.0125, jitter it again with flt_8AB274[ring counter dword_8AAE70++], and use the collision height a3 minus 0.0125.
